[[File:Cow chathead.png|left]]
'''Cows''' are common low [[Combat level|level]] [[monsters]] new players train on. They are one of the first NPCs new players see outside of [[Lumbridge]]. Cows can help new players earn money, [[Cooking]] [[experience]], and [[combat]] experience. The [[cowhide]]s that they [[Drops|drop]] can be tanned to make [[leather]] or [[hard leather]], or they can be sold for [[coins]] to players wanting to raise their [[Crafting]] level. 

While most locations containing cows are crowded, there are some spots usually vacant, like the spot north of the windmill north-west of Lumbridge. Along with cows, you can also find [[Cow calf|cow calves]] and [[dairy cow]]s. Regular cows cannot be milked; attempting to do so using a bucket will display the message {{mes|Only dairy cows are suitable for milking.}}.
